notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hi!

We've been working hard on improving the map, and in this patch we're introducing a rework based on your feedback.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41205884/cbe346e21f0d375cb14b66f1ffa24e4af10ce885.gif

🗺️ The world now feels much more interconnected, with visible links between each map that guide players toward the next biome. This makes it easier to understand how to navigate from one area to the next. We’ve also added distinctive biome colors to make orientation and exploration more intuitive.

📍 We've added a button to center the map on the player's current area, helping you locate yourself more quickly. This works great alongside the map movement improvements we introduced in earlier updates.

🔧 We also fixed achievement-related bugs, where some were unlocking too early or incorrectly along with other minor fixes.

Next, we'll be focusing on adding the feature that displays statuettes on the map once you've paid the cartographer, which will be essential for players aiming for 100% completion. This will be part of our next update!

Thanks so much for all your feedback and support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41205884/c1999a27e811b708ad424ae0718c5b7d8b34c62f.png

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi there!

We want to thank everyone who joined us during this first launch week and shared their constructive feedback with us!

This update includes:

⚙️ General performance improvements for the game.
🗺️ Increased map movement speed.
🕹️ Added tutorials at the beginning to indicate that it's possible to air dash, use the hook with a melee strike, and use the Reconnaissance Bot in the Factory (to avoid potential confusion).
🔧 Fixed various bugs, including one that prevented switching the drone to travel to a checkpoint.
🏕️ Added a camp in the Frozen Peaks area, before reaching the city.
🏆 Achievements: beating the game on Hard now also unlocks Normal and Easy. (To make this happen, you need to load the save file with which you completed the game.)

We're currently working on improving the map, as we believe it's an area that needs to be strengthened. We'll also add the feature where statuettes appear on the map once you've paid the cartographer, to help with 100% game completion and other improvements based on community suggestions.

🕹️ We've also reactivated the demo, featuring the beginning of the game, so new players can try it out and get a feel for the experience!

Thank you all so much! 🙌

notes.title: The full release of Last Vanguard is now available!
notes.notes:
Start your journey today in the full release of Last Vanguard — version 1.0 is live!

[previewyoutube=KIgvwBhZL_0;full][/previewyoutube]

Features:

🪖 28 epic bosses with hand-drawn animations and unique combat styles.
🧭 9 detailed biomes, each featuring exclusive enemies and mechanics.
🎮 15 weapon types that enhance and shape your combat style.
💪 A wide range of active and passive abilities, plus various helmets to customize your experience.

Adapt your strategy and optimize your gear to create a playstyle that's uniquely yours!

Save files from the Early Access version are fully compatible.
To access the final area, you must either speak with The Old Man at the gates of the Coliseum or travel directly to the new zone located just outside the city.

As for Steam Deck, the Steam team has confirmed that the technical issue affecting the tournament area has been resolved.
Last Vanguard is now playable on Steam Deck!

Thank you for being part of this adventure!
We’re especially grateful to everyone who joined and supported us during the Early Access phase — your feedback and input were invaluable.
Without you, the final version of the game wouldn’t have been possible!

We intend to keep improving the game as much as we can, with the support of the community.
Thank you so much!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41205884/c1999a27e811b708ad424ae0718c5b7d8b34c62f.png

notes.title: Last Vanguard's full release is coming on May 15th, 2025!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

After five years of development and six months in Early Access, we are excited to announce that the full 1.0 release is coming on May 15th! 🎉

We want to thank everyone who supported us during this time by purchasing the game and providing feedback. Without your help, this final launch would not have been possible! 🙌

[previewyoutube=KIgvwBhZL_0;full][/previewyoutube]

Last Vanguard 1.0 includes:


🏰 A new area: The Palace of the Absolute Leader, a new place that unlocks after completing the Tournament. (Now a total of 9 different biomes!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41205884/0d7a0cc60235e809517747ef8830670428a577e2.gif

⚔️ Two new final bosses: The Herald and The Absolute Leader — bringing the total to 28 bosses!

Three different difficulty modes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41205884/9429638c090aae4c76983675f2b573b77bce7a32.png

🔹 Easy:
Start with an extra life (from 5 to 8 maximum health with full progression), longer invulnerability time after taking a hit, and in the Tournament, you can charge energy to heal between each battle. 🌟

🔹Normal:
The standard Last Vanguard experience. ⚔️

🔹Challenging:
Thanks to suggestions from some of our players, we’re bringing back the mode originally introduced in the demo! 💀
In this mode, charging bullets consumes energy, meaning you’ll need to land melee attacks to regain energy and be able to shoot.
If you run out of energy, you won’t be able to reload — so you can be left without bullets! 🔥

💀 Boss Life Indicators:
Following community suggestions, we’ve added life indicators for bosses.

🚄 Redesigned Fast Travel:
You can now fast travel to the base, the last checkpoint, or the train — whenever you wish! This allows you to quickly invest your collected money and continue your adventure without losing progress.

🎯Aiming :
Regarding aiming, we chose not to completely overhaul the system, as it would significantly alter the core gameplay experience we’ve built, which is based on a retro-inspired design.
Instead, while enhancing the subtle bullet assistance feature to help you hit your targets more easily.
Also, we've rebalanced and improved some weapons. For example, electric charges, which previously were interrupted by dash or double jump, can now be maintained without interruption as long as the button is held down.

✨ Along with everything new in the full release, thanks to player feedback, several improvements and changes made during Early Access have also been implemented:

🎮 Button Customization:
You can customize your joystick and keyboard controls.

🛠️ General Optimization:
Performance and stability have been improved across the board for a smoother experience.

🗺️ Map System Improvements:

🔹 Custom Markers:
You can place personalized markers on the map, with a variety of models to choose from.

🌫️ Fog of War:
Instead of revealing entire explored areas at once, the map now gradually uncovers small sections as you explore.

🗺️ Cartographer:
A new character will appear at your main base once you’ve built five shelters. For a fee, he can mark hidden upgrades on your map to aid your journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41205884/ea335f0722abb1b625ef48de837f3285100e6611.gif

💀  Boss Difficulty Indicators:
Bosses now appear on the map with stars indicating their difficulty level, helping players decide which ones to face first.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41205884/a63c59e9b278c6e28575a95ac1524f1550394254.png

Player movement improvements 
We’ve made player movement smoother and more responsive for a better gameplay feel.

⚖️ Balance, Bug Fixes, and Quality of Life Improvements:
We’ve fixed various bugs, balanced gameplay, reduced the monetary penalty for death, and introduced several quality-of-life changes to enhance your overall experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41205884/76048dbf4cd9be9f72bc271aa7e1f3b139c785e0.png

Once again, we would like to thank all the users who have collaborated with us. Their contributions and suggestions are mentioned in a special section of the credits.

Regarding previous save files, they are compatible with the latest version. However, some features, like the Fog of War, will only appear in save files created after the update that introduced them.

Additionally, for players who have already completed the Tournament in their current playthrough, you will need to talk the Old Man at the Coliseum gates to unlock the new area.

About Steam Deck:
Unfortunately, we haven't yet completed testing to determine if the game is fully compatible with the console.
For now, Last Vanguard is listed as Unsupported on Steam Deck.
At the time of this post, it is currently under review by the Steam team.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your understanding.
In the meantime, we’ll be focusing our efforts on improving optimization for the device.
Please stay tuned for future updates.

What’s Next?
After the launch of version 1.0, we plan to continue updating the game, addressing feedback, fixing bugs as needed, and—if the community’s support allows—expanding the game with free content in the future.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41205884/c1999a27e811b708ad424ae0718c5b7d8b34c62f.png

notes.title: Update 0.3.0
notes.notes:
Hi! 

We’ve worked hard to improve important aspects of the game based on your feedback. This update brings numerous changes to make the initial experience more accessible and improve the difficulty curve.

Improved difficulty curve:  To make the early game less frustrating and more enjoyable, players now begin with four health points, which can increase to seven with dungeon upgrades. Additionally, after the initial defeat in the Tournament, players in new games must now pass through the tunnels to obtain a gun. This change does not affect current saves, as the weapon was already available but not mandatory. These adjustments will help new players start with stronger equipment and face a more balanced difficulty progression. In the future, we may add different difficulty levels for those seeking an even greater challenge.

Enhanced starting area: We’ve reduced the health of some enemies in the initial area, improved checkpoints, and added energy-generating machines to make this section more accessible for new players.

Faster fast travel:  We increased the speed of fast travel to make getting around the game world quicker.

Boss difficulty indicators:  Bosses now appear on the map with stars indicating their difficulty level, helping players decide which ones to face first. Additionally, players must first defeat a Commander and gain an extra life to access Competitor Luka. This feature will be further refined once the map allows zooming, as currently, certain details may be difficult to see clearly.

Player movement improvements:  We optimized player movement to make it smoother, eliminating the delay after a dash. While we have a few adjustments still to make, particularly with targeted shots, we also added a sound to indicate when abilities are ready to use.

Smoother interface: We improved interface performance for faster and more responsive controls.

Bug fixes: We resolved several bugs reported by the community.

Boss balance adjustments: We’ve adjusted the bosses' health, and they now provide coin rewards in addition to their unique rewards or objectives. If a boss still seems to have too much health, let us know in the discussions!

We’re excited about these updates and the improvements they bring to the game experience. Next, we’ll focus on enhancing the map, including an NPC who will mark upgrades for a fee, add zoom functionality, and more. We will also continue working on optimizations and game balance to ensure a more polished experience.

Thank you for your support, suggestions, and patience as we continue working to make this experience as enjoyable as possible!

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.notes:
General Optimization:
Since the game's launch, we've been working hard to optimize performance. The game now runs more smoothly, though we are still working on reducing the initial loading screen time.

What are we working on now?
Our top priority right now is addressing the feedback we've received regarding the game's difficulty, the health of the final bosses, and the lack of money as a reward for defeating them. We are actively working to improve and optimize the bosses' health and make the overall gameplay more enjoyable.

After balancing these aspects, we'll focus on refining the map to make it more intuitive and polishing the player experience.

We appreciate your support, apologize for any inconveniences, and thank you for your patience. Our goal is to make the game as enjoyable and engaging as possible.
